hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: A custom-curve hook for ETH/phiEth pools that implements 1:1 swapping by intercepting beforeSwap, taking the input token, converting it via phiEth deposit/withdraw, settling the output, and returning a BeforeSwapDelta that no-ops the AMM math. Liquidity addition is blocked; the hook enforces an ETH/phiEth token pair and zero fee at pool initialization.
